summary.text: Larry Pemberton Jr. was sworn into the Connecticut House of Representatives on January 21, 2026, as a Democrat representing the 139th House district of Norwich, Ledyard and Montville.

paragraphs.text: Pemberton is a member of the Eastern Pequot Tribal Nation, which says he is the first Native American elected to the General Assembly.

sources.title: Larry Pemberton Jr. becomes first Native American elected to CT General Assembly
